name: Sake
siboNotes: Alcohol can potentially worsen SIBO symptoms and may slow gut motility, so consume in moderation if you have SIBO.
preparationTips: Choose pure sake without added sugars or flavorings
Serve chilled or at room temperature as preferred
Consume with FODMAP-friendly foods to minimize digestive impact
Limit to one serving to avoid overwhelming the digestive system
nutritionalHighlights: Contains amino acids from rice fermentation
Lower alcohol content than most spirits (14-16%)
